title: World footbridges — wave two strict-gate research dossiers

category_proposal.label: Footbridges
category_proposal.editorial_contract: A named, publicly walkable, motor-vehicle-free bridge, suspension bridge, footbridge, canopy walkway or boardwalk where crossing the structure itself is the memorable walking experience.
positive_tests: The structure is visually legible, surprising or story-rich from the public walking route.
The crossing itself, rather than an attraction reached by it, is the objective.
Shared pedestrian-and-cycle use is acceptable when motor vehicles are excluded and the walking experience remains primary.
hard_rejects: vehicular bridge with only a pavement
seasonal river crossing requiring hazard judgement
duplicate better represented by architecture, industrial, view or oddity

overpass_intent: named bridge=yes with highway=footway|path|pedestrian and foot=yes|designated
named bridge=suspension or bridge:structure=suspension on a public walking route
named canopy_walk or boardwalk whose full structure is the destination
mandatory_review_flags: public access and hours or fees
surface, steps, width and exposure where officially supported
whether bridge story wins over an existing category

hard_gates.current_access: A current official, municipal or land-manager source must establish public pedestrian access and structural status.
hard_gates.identity_story: An authoritative source must establish the exact named structure and its specific story.
hard_gates.coordinates: Coordinates must lie on a named bridge route, mapped outline or exact official route point, not a parking area or generic attraction pin.
hard_gates.safety: No current damage closure, technical route, uncontrolled seasonal ford or crossing requiring individual river-hazard judgement.
hard_gates.category_coherence: Crossing the bridge must be the memorable experience; stronger existing category narratives take precedence.

dedupe.exact_scope: IDs, normalized names, aliases, translated names and external IDs against the global catalogue and every retained internal candidate.
dedupe.result: No retained candidate is within 120 metres of another retained candidate or an existing catalogue row. Alexandra Bridge is 260 metres from the broad existing Cataract Gorge entry and is a distinct structure.

validation_contract.production: The 33 retained rows were imported after reviewed city additions, live-model validation, a fresh current-status check and global dedupe. They remain quality d pending human editorial promotion and must not be re-imported.

notes: Two exact generic catalogue-name collisions were manually cleared: Liberty Bridge (Budapest versus Greenville) and Peace Bridge (Buffalo–Fort Erie versus Calgary).
The existing Cataract Gorge entry is 260 metres from Alexandra Suspension Bridge; the retained row is the newly restored named crossing, not a duplicate of the broad gorge.
The applied Holzgau and Bellinzona entries now route Holzgau and Carasc to their reviewed live city boxes instead of neighbouring margin matches.
Arapuni Suspension Bridge was deferred after Mercury's live enhancement-project page established that swing-bridge access will close as main works begin from August 2026.

Pedro e Inês Bridge was deferred because contemporaneous reports reproducing Coimbra's 1 February municipal notice said it remained closed until a new safety evaluation, and no later municipal reopening notice surfaced through 9 August.

SANParks' 16 July notice states that full public access to Storms River Mouth would resume from 1 August 2026; no later extension or closure surfaced through 9 August. This is an official effective-date statement, not a post-reopening observation, so same-day alerts remain mandatory.

included.s: A 516-metre mesh crossing hung above the Paiva gorge
included.w: The see-through metal deck makes the 175-metre drop part of every step across this long suspension bridge. Its two official approaches turn the crossing into either a short outing or a steep Paiva gorge walk.
facts: The suspended span is 516 metres long.
The deck is metal grating and reaches 175 metres above the river.
The Areinho approach includes roughly 500 steps.

included.s: Douglas-fir boards floating 100 metres above a Hunsrück valley

included.s: Ninety-nine steps stitched across the Vøringsfossen ravine

facts: The bridge links the Fossli and Fossatromma sides of the waterfall area.
The crossing contains 99 steps.
It opened in 2020 as one stage of the national scenic-route project.

facts: The bridge is 140 metres long.
The deck is about 70 metres above the valley.
The crossing opened to the public in December 2018.

Its maximum height above the Lima riverbed is 36 metres.
It opened in 1923 as a workers' route to the SMI factories.
